ApiError.title: ApiError
ApiError.description: The error envelope. `error` is the stable code; `message` is free prose.

field.description: The rejected filter or sort field, on the four codes that name one.

fields.description: The undeclared body keys, sorted, on unknown_fields.

issues.description: Every problem with the body, on validation.

code.description: A Zod issue name. A client that does not know one treats it as custom.

path.description: The location of the field in the body.

maxLimit.description: The largest page the server serves, on limit_too_large.

couponAmount.description: A decimal, as a string in JSON-number grammar or a JSON number. Precision 10, scale 2.
